35126-little-tom.title: Little Tom
35126-little-tom.creator: Unknown
35126-little-tom.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The hut had one large room, a small chamber and the black kitchen, with its great fireplace and broad chimney. From the outside, it looked not unlike the houses of the villagers; but, inside, stood furniture of an older day. In a corner stood a bed of polished wood, piled high with white, downy quilts and covers. In the middle of the room was a round table with smooth, polished chairs set against it.

arxiv-2103-10017.title: Extraction of Proton Trace Anomaly Energy from Near-Threshold ϕ \phi and J / ψ J/\psi photo-productions
arxiv-2103-10017.creator: Wei Kou, Rong Wang, Xurong Chen
arxiv-2103-10017.description: Abstract The trace anomalous energy contribution to the proton mass is a very important topic in non-perturbative QCD and hadron physics. In experiments, it is under the hot discussions on how to measure the trace anomalous energy. The QCD interpretation of proton trace anomaly is still not clear.

arxiv-2207-05625.title: Nonlinear wave interactions in geochemical modeling.
arxiv-2207-05625.creator: A. C. Alvarez, J. Bruining, D. Marchesin
arxiv-2207-05625.description: Abstract This paper is concerned with the study of the main wave interactions in a system of conservation laws in geochemical modeling. We study the modeling of the chemical complexes on the rock surface. The presence of stable surface complexes affects the relative permeability.

arxiv-2305-08157.title: Algorithmic Pluralism: A Structural Approach To Equal Opportunity DOI: 10.1145/3630106.3658899 Conference: The 2024 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency; June 3–6, 2024; Rio de Janeiro, Brazil The 2024 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT ’24),
arxiv-2305-08157.creator: Shomik Jain 1 , Vinith M. Suriyakumar 2 , Kathleen A. Creel 3 , and Ashia C. Wilson 1,2
arxiv-2305-08157.description: Abstract . We present a structural approach toward achieving equal opportunity in systems of algorithmic decision-making called algorithmic pluralism . Algorithmic pluralism describes a state of affairs in which no set of algorithms severely limits access to opportunity, allowing individuals the freedom to pursue a diverse range of life paths.

arxiv-2309-15300.title: Wasserstein convergence in Bayesian and frequentist deconvolution models
arxiv-2309-15300.creator: [, Judith Rousseau and Catia Scricciolo, [, Judith Rousseau and Catia Scricciolo
arxiv-2309-15300.description: Abstract We study the multivariate deconvolution problem of recovering the distribution of a signal from independent and identically distributed observations additively contaminated with random errors (noise) from a known distribution. We investigate whether a Bayesian nonparametric approach for modelling the latent distribution of the signal can yield inferences with frequentist asymptotic validity under the L 1 L^{1} -Wasserstein metric.

arxiv-2502-15305.title: A Permutation-equivariant Deep Learning Model for Quantum State Characterization
arxiv-2502-15305.creator: D. Maragnano, C. Cusano, M. Liscidini
arxiv-2502-15305.description: Abstract The characterization of quantum states is a fundamental step of any application of quantum technologies. Nowadays there exist several approaches addressing this problem, also based on machine and deep learning techniques. However, all these approaches usually require a number of measurement that scales exponentially with the number of parties composing the system.

arxiv-2510-23565.description: Abstract This work is part of a series establishing the redshift framework for the 3 × 2 3\times 2 pt analysis of the Dark Energy Survey Year 6 (DES Y6). For DES Y6, photometric redshift distributions are estimated using self-organizing maps (SOMs), calibrated with spectroscopic and many-band photometric data.

arxiv-2511-02680.title: On the Convergence of the Extended Kalman Filter on Stiefel Manifolds when Observing a Constant Particle with Measurement Errors
arxiv-2511-02680.creator: Jordi-Lluís Figueras, Aron Persson, Lauri Viitasaari
arxiv-2511-02680.description: Abstract . In this paper we first introduce the setting of filtering on Stiefel manifolds. Then, assuming the underlying system process is constant, the convergence of the extended Kalman filter with Stiefel manifold-valued observations is proved. This corresponds to the case where one has measurement errors that needs to be filtered.

pmc-10665596.title: Multi-omics analysis in developmental bone biology
pmc-10665596.creator: Yuki Matsushita, Azumi Noguchi, Wanida Ono, Noriaki Ono
pmc-10665596.description: Single-cell omics and multi-omics have revolutionized our understanding of molecular and cellular biological processes at a single-cell level. In bone biology, the combination of single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses and in vivo lineage-tracing approaches has successfully identified multi-cellular diversity and dynamics of skeletal cells.

pmc-10679971.title: C9orf142 transcriptionally activates MTBP to drive progression and resistance to CDK4/6 inhibitor in triple‐negative breast cancer
pmc-10679971.creator: Li Liao, Ling Deng, Yin‐Ling Zhang, Shao‐Ying Yang, Lisa Andriani, Shu‐Yuan Hu, Fang‐Lin Zhang, Zhi‐Min Shao, Da‐Qiang Li
pmc-10679971.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundTriple‐negative breast cancer (TNBC) presents the most challenging subtype of all breast cancers because of its aggressive clinical phenotypes and absence of viable therapy targets. In order to identify effective molecular targets for treating patients with TNBC, we conducted an integration analysis of our recently published TNBC dataset of quantitative proteomics and RNA‐Sequencing, and found the abnormal upregulation of chromosome 9 open reading frame 142 (C9orf142) in TNBC.

pmc-10718072.title: Computationally guided bioengineering of the active site, substrate access pathway, and water channels of thermostable cytochrome P450, CYP175A1, for catalyzing the alkane hydroxylation reaction†
pmc-10718072.creator: Mohd Taher, Kshatresh Dutta Dubey, Shyamalava Mazumdar
pmc-10718072.description: Understanding structure–function relationships in proteins is pivotal in their development as industrial biocatalysts. In this regard, rational engineering of protein active site access pathways and various tunnels and channels plays a central role in designing competent enzymes with high stability and enhanced efficiency.

pmc-10740507.title: Training Postural Balance Control with Pelvic Force Field at the Boundary of Stability
pmc-10740507.creator: Isirame Omofuma, Victor Santamaria, Xupeng Ai, Sunil Agrawal, Antonio Boccaccio
pmc-10740507.description: This study characterizes the effects of a postural training program on balance and muscle control strategies in a virtual reality (VR) environment. The Robotic Upright Stand Trainer (RobUST), which applies perturbative forces on the trunk and assistive forces on the pelvis, was used to deliver perturbation-based balance training (PBT) in a sample of 10 healthy participants.

pmc-11348263.title: Light regulates widespread plant alternative polyadenylation through the chloroplast
pmc-11348263.creator: M. Guillermina Kubaczka, Micaela A. Godoy Herz, Wei-Chun Chen, Dinghai Zheng, Ezequiel Petrillo, Bin Tian, Alberto R. Kornblihtt
pmc-11348263.description: SignificanceLight is not only a source of energy but also a regulator of plant physiological adaptations. We previously showed that light affects alternative splicing in Arabidopsis thaliana. We report now that light also controls alternative cleavage/polyadenylation in approximately 30% of Arabidopsis genes.

pmc-11494083.title: Engineering band structures of two-dimensional materials with remote moiré ferroelectricity
pmc-11494083.creator: Jing Ding, Hanxiao Xiang, Wenqiang Zhou, Naitian Liu, Qianmei Chen, Xinjie Fang, Kangyu Wang, Linfeng Wu, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Na Xin, Shuigang Xu
pmc-11494083.description: The stacking order and twist angle provide abundant opportunities for engineering band structures of two-dimensional materials, including the formation of moiré bands, flat bands, and topologically nontrivial bands. The inversion symmetry breaking in rhombohedral-stacked transitional metal dichalcogenides endows them with an interfacial ferroelectricity associated with an out-of-plane electric polarization.

pmc-12397479.title: Lithium-Ion Dynamic Interface Engineering of Nano-Charged Composite Polymer Electrolytes for Solid-State Lithium-Metal Batteries
pmc-12397479.creator: Shanshan Lv, Jingwen Wang, Yuanming Zhai, Yu Chen, Jiarui Yang, Zhiwei Zhu, Rui Peng, Xuewei Fu, Wei Yang, Yu Wang
pmc-12397479.description: Highlights The surface charge characteristics of halloysite nanotubes (HNTs) are manipulated to engineer the Li+-dynamic interface (Li+-DI) in composite polymer electrolytes.Surface charge characteristics of HNTs generate pronounced impact on not only the ionic/mechanical properties of the composite electrolytes, but also the formation and composition of solid–electrolyte interphase (SEI) layer.

pmc-12995440.title: Cyclopyranil (Pesticides)
pmc-12995440.creator: Food Safety Commission of Japan
pmc-12995440.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Food Safety Commission of Japan (FSCJ) conducted a risk assessment of cyclopyranil (CAS No. 1651191-47-7), a pyrazolylpyrazole herbicide, based on results from submitted documents. The data used in the assessment include fate in plants (paddy rice), residues in crops, fate in animals (rats), subacute toxicity (rats, mice and dogs), chronic toxicity (dogs), combined chronic toxicity/carcinogenicity (rats), carcinogenicity (mice), two-generation reproductive toxicity (rats), developmental toxicity (rats and rabbits) and genotoxicity.

pmc-13040509.title: Bulk and Surface Dual‐Modification for Stabilizing RuO2 Anode in 2 A cm−2 PEMWE Operation
pmc-13040509.creator: Jiayi Tang, Zijun Fang, Yu‐Cheng Huang, Daqin Guan, Bin Chen, Zongping Shao
pmc-13040509.description: RuO2 is a promising alternative to IrO2 for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in proton exchange membrane water electrolyzers (PEMWEs). However, to date, only Ir oxide or IrRu‐oxide based anodes have demonstrated possible stable operation at industrial‐relevant current densities of 2 A cm−2 for practical PEMWE applications.

pmc-13239499.title: Anterior tibial translation versus rotational instability in ACL reconstruction: Defining the problem before choosing the procedure
pmc-13239499.creator: Tomas Pineda, David H Dejour, Volker Musahl, Romain Seil, Stefano Zaffagnini, Matthieu Ollivier
pmc-13239499.description: so referred to as slope‐reducing anterior closing wedge high tibial osteotomy—in anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction reflects meaningful progress in our understanding of mechanisms of graft failure. pmc-13321798.title: Identification of Streptococcus pyogenes isolates with reduced beta-lactam susceptibility in a cohort of children with pharyngitis
pmc-13321798.creator: Daniel B. Amusin, Lacy M. Simons, Dulce S. Garcia, Samuel W. M. Gatesy, Sophia H. Nozick, Jennifer Sheridan, Alan R. Hauser, Emma Office, Preeti Jaggi, David B. Williams, Rachel J. Tanz, Yiannis Katsogridakis, Larry K. Kociolek, Ami B. Patel, Stanford T. Shulman, Judith A. Guzman-Cottrill, Robert R.
pmc-13321798.description: We investigated sequences of the penicillin-binding protein 2x (PBP2x) among 902 Streptococcus pyogenes isolates from children with pharyngitis. Twenty-five pharyngeal isolates carried variants associated with reduced β-lactam susceptibility. Penicillin and ampicillin susceptibility testing confirmed reduced susceptibility among PBP2x variant isolates relative to those with the wild-type sequence.

pmc-13662253.title: Effect of Hand Grip Exercise on Rotator Cuff Strength and Shoulder Function Recovery after Arthroscopic Rotator Cuff Repair: A Prospective Randomized Controlled Trial
